signin.headline: Everyone's photos, one shared album.
signin.sub: Sign in to create an album and share it. Then anyone can join with the link — no account needed.
signin.failed: That did not work. Check the password, or wait a few minutes if there were several wrong tries.
signin.denied: This copy of Mira is not taking new accounts. Ask whoever runs it to let you in. Joining an album with an invitation link never needs an account.
signin.noProviders: No sign-in providers are configured yet.
signin.reassure: Got an invite link? Just open it — joining never needs an account.
op.runBy: This copy of Mira is run by {name}.
op.runByUnknown: This is a private copy of Mira, run by whoever sent you the link.
op.keptDefault: Photos and videos stay here until the people who added them, or the album’s owner, delete them.
privacy.who.project: Mira is open-source software that people install on their own server. Whoever runs this copy is responsible for it; the Mira project does not see or hold anything stored here.
privacy.what.media: The photos and videos people add, exactly as they were taken. That includes what the camera wrote into the file, such as the date and, if location was switched on, the place.
privacy.what.guest: For guests: the name you typed when you joined, and a random code in a cookie so this device is recognised next time. No email, no phone number, no account.
privacy.what.owner: For album owners: the name, email address and picture supplied by the sign-in service they chose.
privacy.see.body: Everyone in an album can see and download everything in it, including where a photo was taken. Anyone who has the invitation link can join, so share it only with people you would show the photos to. The person who runs the server can access the files.
privacy.long.delete: You can delete anything you added, at any time, from its own screen. An album’s owner can delete anything in their album, or the whole album. Deleted files are removed from the server within minutes; backups made by whoever runs the server may keep them a while longer.
privacy.track.body: No advertising, no analytics and no trackers. Mira sets only the cookies it needs: one to recognise this device, one to keep an owner signed in, and one to remember your language. Nothing is loaded from other companies; a map opens on another site only if you tap a place.
privacy.ask.h: Questions, or a photo you want removed
privacy.ask.body: Ask the album’s owner, or the person who runs this copy, to remove a photo of you or to answer a question about it.
home.emptyBody: Create one, share the link, and everyone's photos & videos land in one place.
create.hint: Name it and you're in — share the link after.
edit.deleteWarn: All the photos and videos in this album will be gone for everyone. This cannot be undone.
join.title: Join “{album}” 👋
join.tagline: One tap and you're in — pick a name your friends will recognise. No account, no email.
join.originals: Photos and videos are shared as originals, including when and where they were taken.
join.originalsVideoCopies: Photos are shared as originals, including when and where they were taken. Videos in this album are kept as smaller copies.
join.nameTaken: Someone called “{name}” is already in this album. Add an initial or a surname so friends can tell you apart.
join.previewDescription: Add your photos and videos and download everyone else’s. No account, no app.
join.expired.title: This invitation no longer works
join.expired.body: The owner of “{album}” has replaced the link. Ask them for the new one.
return.title: Come back to “{album}” as {name}
return.body: This device will take {name}’s place in the album: the name, the uploads and the favourites. The device that had it before will be asked to join again.
return.invalid.title: This link no longer works
return.invalid.body: It has already been used, or it has expired. Ask the album’s owner for a new one.
opts.approveUploadsSub: Review each photo before it appears
opts.closeSub: Nothing new can be added. Everyone can still look and download.
opts.vq.originalSub: Videos play straight from the original file. Big clips start slowly, and some phone formats do not play in every browser.
opts.vq.losslessSub: Practically identical to the original. Saves little, sometimes nothing (then no copy is made), and takes the longest.
opts.vq.balancedSub: Same picture size as the original; the copy is usually less than half its size.
opts.vq.smallSub: Videos start at once, even on a slow connection. Picture reduced to 720p: a 1 GB clip typically plays from a copy of under 100 MB.
opts.vq.note: The original video is always kept untouched: it is what Download and every ZIP give. The copy is only for watching in the album. Photos are never changed. Applies to videos added from now on.
opts.vq.noteSaveSpace: Originals are NOT kept in this album: each new video is replaced by its copy, and the copy is what people download. Photos are never changed. Applies to videos added from now on.
opts.saveSpace: Save space: keep only the small copy
opts.saveSpaceSub: The original video is deleted as soon as its copy is made and cannot be recovered. Downloads then give the copy. Turn on only if disk space is short.
admin.title: Admin
admin.users.search: Search by name, email or provider
admin.reg.title: Registration
admin.reg.hintOpen: Anyone can sign in and become an owner.
admin.reg.hintClosed: Only existing accounts can sign in — no new accounts.
admin.reg.hintAllowlist: Only listed emails or @domains may create an account.
admin.limits.title: Limits
admin.maint.title: Maintenance
admin.quota.title: Storage quota
admin.quota.hintWithDefault: Leave blank to use the platform default of {n} MB. Enter 0 for unlimited.
admin.quota.hintUnlimited: Leave blank to use the platform default (unlimited). Enter 0 for unlimited.
admin.delete.title: Delete account
admin.delete.alsoAlbumsSub: All albums owned by this account and their media will also be permanently deleted.
admin.delete.otherMembershipsSub: Their uploads to other albums remain, but their member name is anonymized and their old browser access is revoked.
board.empty.title: Nothing here yet
board.empty.body: Tap + Share below to add the first photos or videos, or invite your friends and let them start.
board.closed.banner: This album is closed: nothing new can be added. You can still look and download.
board.myPending.one: Your upload is waiting for the owner’s approval. Only you can see it until then.
board.myPending.many: {n} of your uploads are waiting for the owner’s approval. Only you can see them until then.
board.pendingMine: Only you can see this until the owner approves it
board.pendingOwner: Waiting for your approval: only you and {by} can see this
board.pagination.label: Media pages
board.video.queued: Waiting for another video to finish compressing…
board.video.keepOpen: Keep this page open until the upload finishes.
board.video.canLeave: Your video is safely uploaded. You can close this page; it will appear in the album when it is ready.
board.video.reconnecting: Connection lost. Trying again… nothing is lost.
board.video.reduced: Reduced copy — the original was not kept · {size}
board.menu.label: Album menu
board.menu.closeSub: Nothing new can be added; still viewable and downloadable
board.menu.reopenSub: Let people add photos and videos again
board.menu.letBackInSub: For a guest with a new phone or a cleared browser
board.menu.moveDeviceSub: Keep your name and your uploads on a new phone
board.return.pick: Who needs to get back in?
board.return.none: There are no guests to let back in. People with an account just sign in.
board.return.ready: Send this link to {name}. It works once, within 24 hours, and moves {name} to the device that opens it.
board.return.readySelf: Open this on your other device within 15 minutes: scan the code or copy the link. It works once and moves you there; this device will then be asked to join again.
board.name: Name
board.invite.title: Invite friends
board.invite.hint: One tap and they're in — no account, no app store.
board.invite.msg: Join “{album}” on Mira — share & grab our photos:
board.invite.qrAlt: QR code to join this album
board.invite.printCardSub: For the table, the door or the invitation
board.invite.resetSub: The current link and QR code stop letting new people in. Everyone already here stays.
board.invite.resetConfirm: Reset the invitation link? The link and QR code you have already shared will stop working for new people.
board.view.title: View
board.view.label: View options
board.share.title: Share photos
board.share.videosReduced: Videos added to this album are kept as a smaller copy; the original is not stored.
board.download.title: Download
board.download.hint: Grab a zip — now or later.
board.download.videosHint: Full quality gives each video exactly as it was uploaded. Smaller files download much faster. Photos are always full quality.
board.rename.title: Rename moment
board.rename.hint: Give this part of the timeline a clearer name.
board.moment.title: New moment
board.moment.hint: A new stop / occasion on the timeline.
board.personalize.title: Personalise
board.personalize.hint: Optional polish — the app works fully without touching this.
board.lightbox.label: Photo
board.lightbox.openMap: Open the place on a map
board.toast.pendingItem: Added — waiting for the owner’s approval
board.toast.pendingItems: Added {n} — waiting for the owner’s approval
board.toast.linkReset: New link ready. The old one no longer lets anyone in.
card.scan: Scan to add your photos and videos
card.noAccount: No account and no app: it opens in your browser.
board.deletePhotoConfirm: Delete this from the album? It is removed for everyone.
board.upload.tooLarge: Too big — max {max} MB per photo
board.upload.tooManyPixels: Too many pixels — max {max} megapixels per photo
board.upload.notMedia: Only photos and videos can be added
srv.signInToCreate: Please sign in to create an album.

srv.albumLimit: You've reached your limit of {max} albums.
srv.cantChangeOwnAdmin: You can't change your own admin status.
srv.videoTooLarge: Video is too large — max {max} MB.
srv.albumClosed: This album is closed: nothing new can be added.
srv.albumSettingsUnreadable: The settings of this album cannot be read right now, so nothing was changed. Try again later, or tell whoever runs this server.
srv.returnGuestsOnly: Only a guest without an account can be moved to another device.
srv.serverFull: The server does not have enough free space for this video right now. Please tell the album's owner.
srv.uploadIncomplete: Could not assemble the upload because a chunk is missing.
srv.uploaderOrOwnerOnly: Only the uploader or album owner can delete this.
srv.posterVideosOnly: Posters can only be set for videos.
error.hint: Check the link you were given, or ask whoever shared it to send it again.
